nodes.label: Auto sort_order Assignment
nodes.rationale: sort_order is assigned as the 0-based index of the test_cases array to preserve CSV original order in UI

nodes.label: Auto-inject _title Column
nodes.rationale: _title is auto-injected if not present in extra_columns to guarantee data-driven mode and eliminate legacy hardcoded columns

nodes.label: Auto-derivation of col_id from Header
nodes.rationale: col_id is derived from header text via regex normalization, with reserved IDs overriding for known field names

nodes.label: Cycle Status Derivation Logic
nodes.rationale: Cycle status is recomputed from ALL executions: any FAIL → FAILED, all PASS/SKIP → PASSED, any PENDING/BLOCKED → IN_PROGRESS

nodes.label: Idempotent Result Reporting
nodes.rationale: Result reporting is idempotent via upsert on case_id, allowing safe retries

nodes.label: QA Hub Roles and Permissions Matrix
nodes.norm_label: qa hub roles and permissions matrix

nodes.label: RLS Permission Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Permissions are enforced both at frontend (UI visibility) and backend (Supabase RLS policies) to ensure consistent access control

nodes.label: Main Branch Workflow (direct push to main)
nodes.rationale: Code changes land straight on the default branch to keep workflow simple
nodes.norm_label: main branch workflow (direct push to main)

nodes.label: SDD Methodology Selected
nodes.rationale: SDD (Specification-Driven Development) selected because project has authentication and persistence complexity

nodes.label: Three-Lane Decisor (Answer / FTD / ASDD)
nodes.rationale: Every turn is classified into Answer (read-only), FTD (single feature), or ASDD (complex chain) to control scope and prevent unintended changes
